plan: Model the component as a single CheckInConsole class holding a defensively copied appointment list, a precomputed set of known ids, and the public session dict mutated in place so external references survive begin/abandon resets.

Route handle(action) through a dispatch table of per-action handler methods; each handler validates preconditions and payload fields completely before any state assignment, guaranteeing invalid actions cannot corrupt accepted data.
Centralize screen construction in one _screen builder that attaches appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment' and empty choices otherwise, keeping the screen shape uniform.

Derive prompts from state: _next_prompt walks the unmet-step order (contact -> appointment -> review) for accepted confirmations and corrections; _current_prompt extends it with idle/completed cases so error screens show a sensible prompt with an 'Error: ...' first message.

Implement run_once to raise RuntimeError before touching either adapter when one is missing, then perform exactly one read_action, one handle, one display, returning the identical screen object; source and sink are duck-typed so standard-library unittest fakes drop in directly.
mechanisms: in-place mutated public session dictionary with a single reset routine
dispatch table mapping action types to guard-first handler methods
validate-before-mutate handlers ensuring error paths never change accepted data
centralized screen builder enforcing the choices-only-on-'Choose appointment' invariant
state-derived prompt computation (_next_prompt / _current_prompt) shared by accepted and error screens
duck-typed action_source/screen_sink adapters with a fail-fast RuntimeError in run_once
